title: HF1765 (2023-2024 Regular): Retired law enforcement officers permitted to carry firearms in schools.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-14; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/1765/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced bill (as filed), 2023-02-14. No votes recorded. The only change is new clause (f)(10); the rest of the subdivision is existing law reprinted. Effective August 1, 2023.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): Except as provided under paragraphs (d) and (f), whoever possesses, stores, or keeps a dangerous weapon while knowingly on school property is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000, or both.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (10) persons authorized to carry a firearm under United States Code, title 18, part I, chapter 44, section 926C, and who are carrying in compliance with that law.
